name: Nelson E. Martinez
office: Wiseburn Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Nelson E. Martinez is a member of the Wiseburn Unified School District Governing Board, having served since 2005 and twice as board president. He says he helped guide the district through unification and the growth of its partnership with Da Vinci Schools. He also says he helped establish Da Vinci Schools. He works as Executive Vice President of Element Consulting, a firm that manages construction programs for educational facilities. His campaign says this experience strengthens his ability to provide long-range planning and fiscal oversight for the district.
